BrochureContent.Content:
DNG McKenna Healy are delighted to present No. 4 Dublin Road, a superb four-bedroom semi-detached bungalow ideally positioned within walking distance of Skerries town centre and all local amenities.

This impressive single-storey home has been extensively refurbished and thoughtfully extended to an exceptional standard, creating a bright, spacious and beautifully presented property that is ready for immediate occupation. Combining generous proportions with high-quality finishes and a versatile layout, No. 4 Dublin Road offers an ideal home for modern family living in one of North County Dublin's most sought-after coastal locations.

From the moment you step inside, the quality and attention to detail are immediately apparent. The accommodation is presented in turnkey condition throughout, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere and an abundance of natural light.

At the heart of the home is a superb open-plan kitchen and living space, providing a generous and sociable area that is equally suited to family life, entertaining and relaxed everyday living. The property offers four generously proportioned bedrooms, with three benefiting from their own en-suite bathrooms, providing an excellent level of privacy and convenience for both family members and guests.

A further highlight is the spacious attic room, which offers valuable additional flexibility and could be ideally suited as a home office, playroom, hobby space or additional family room, depending on the needs of the new owner.

The rear garden is undoubtedly one of the property's standout features. West-facing and exceptionally private, it has been carefully landscaped to create a peaceful outdoor retreat surrounded by mature trees and established planting. The manicured lawns and patio areas provide an ideal setting for outdoor dining and entertaining, while also offering a safe and attractive space for children to play or simply to relax and enjoy the afternoon and evening sun.

The location is equally impressive. Skerries is a vibrant and much-loved seaside town, renowned for its beautiful beaches, picturesque coastline, strong community atmosphere and excellent range of local amenities. There is an outstanding choice of sporting and recreational facilities close by, including golf, sailing, rugby, GAA and tennis clubs.

For commuters, the property is exceptionally well connected, with both Skerries railway station and bus services within a few minutes' walk. The M1 motorway and Dublin Airport are approximately 12 miles away, providing convenient access to Dublin City and beyond.
